1879239562.name: Discipline: Riddermark
1879239562.desc:
<rgb=#66fff>Mounted Discipline</rgb>

Mounted Disciplines are used to alter the attitude and tactics used by your War-steed in Mounted Combat.

<rgb=#66ffff>Riddermark</rgb>
The Riddermark Discipline turns your focus toward controlling the tempo of battle against your enemies. Skills can influence the speed and attitude of your opponents throughout the course of battle.

1879241994.name: Discipline: Rohirrim
1879241994.desc:
<rgb=#66fff>Mounted Discipline</rgb>

Mounted Disciplines are used to alter the attitude and tactics used by your War-steed in Mounted Combat.

<rgb=#66ffff>Rohirrim</rgb>

The Rohirrim Discipline turns your focus to steeling yourself against the enemy's attack, drawing their ire and defending your allies from enemy assaults.

1879248010.name: Spear-toss
1879248010.desc: You throw the spear at the target. Your odds of striking it are roughly even.

1879263626.name: Lay Trap
1879263626.desc: Your skill in combat and experience with trapping allow you to lay snares on the go. You throw down a trap behind you that will last for a short period of time or until triggered by an enemy.\n\n<rgb=#FF0000>Applies a 10s Fear effect to the first enemy who triggers the trap.</rgb>

1879315082.name: Counterattack
1879315082.desc: While under the effect of Counter, evading an attack allows you to freely strike your target.
